rounds: I would rather spend a Friday evening gaming than going out.
Video games about war make real war seem more acceptable.
I would join a part-time reserve if it paid better than my student job.
Children under 16 shouldn’t be allowed to play online games with strangers.
Drones should be banned from flying over cities, except in emergencies.
Fighting a war from a screen thousands of miles away still takes real courage.
Drones will make future wars less deadly for everyone.
Twenty years from now, most soldiers will never leave their own country.
